description: Zones de stationnement payant - Angers is a dataset listed in Angers Loire Métropole - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Angers Loire Métropole. Zone de stationnement payant de la Ville d'Angers. Emprise géographiques des deux zones de stationnement payant du territoire de la Ville d'Angers. La valeur LIENWEB correspond aux tarifs de stationnement voirie (voir doc). Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Stationnement. Its keywords are stationnement, parking, Catalogue SIG. The portal shows 14 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
